items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: I know the lady got to be, I saw her about three years ago.

ctx.x: That was the Dave Otholomew's band. And Miss Gladys DeVore, the lady, I wonder if she's still living. I know the lady got to be, I saw her about three years ago. She live up on Valens near Chappatulas. Yeah, near Chappatulas, a magazine, near Magazine. Yeah. And she wrote, I'm going to cross that river. But it was the regular Dave Otholomew band. The regular, you know.
